development.data_selection: First replica of every layout, all outcomes retained. Teacher trajectories at fractions0,0.25,0.5,0.75 of decision count for repair; competitor base trajectories at fractions0,0.5 for identity preservation; floor(f*(n-1)), deduplicate. No baseline-original trajectories enter adaptation.
development.qualification_note: 16 exact-slot original repeats and16 teacher repeats per case quantify unchanged-policy variation;16 full-horizon cube-only episodes replace the early-stop diagnostic for adaptation. Preserve all original diagnostics.

left_screen.rule: First of three declared variants with>=4/16 strict success; no further search if none.

heldout.wordings: Two target paraphrases per case are withheld from both weight-adaptation procedures. Primary preservation uses the known competent reverse-order and stacking wordings on fresh layouts/noise; additional stress-test strings are unseen. Competing intents are seen in identity-preservation data. Operator-authored, not a blind natural-language benchmark.
heldout.runtime_gate: validate resets, replay parity, data hashes before heldout; candidates frozen once; no test-driven tuning

closed_form.pooling: 32 repair image cells averaged over training repair observations; individual preservation keys with mean-per-observation penalty
closed_form.ridge_scale: relative ridge times mean squared norm of repair keys only

lora.objective: native flow-matching with teacher action chunks
lora.selection: Bounded development-only tuning: nominate one of two NEW rates by balanced validation action MSE; choose between nominee and original1e-3 by strict closed-loop development success. No heldout selection.

tuning.nomination_metric: Equal-weight mean of repair and preservation physical action MSE on the fixed eight development validation observations
tuning.final_selection_metric: Maximum total strict selected-goal successes across original and primary preservation (32 trials per candidate)
tuning.boundary: All feedback is development-only; original fits and all trials preserved; all fitting and validation costs reported. This is a bounded tuned baseline, not a global optimization claim.

live_replay.batch_context: Actual active requests recovered from sealed source observation step arrays

validation.singleton_to_live_difference: Measured diagnostic, not an input-identity gate. BF16 kernels vary with batch/graph shape.

reporting.secondary: stock-compatible predicates, competing-goal success at selected endpoint, ever-achieved outcomes labeled separately
reporting.pairing: same layout and policy noise stream across conditions; record image/pose differences
reporting.uncertainty: paired counts and exploratory layout-cluster intervals; eight layout clusters are not a population claim
reporting.preservation: 16episodes/cell cannot establish tight equivalence; failures and collisions reported
reporting.cost: collection + teacher generation + capture/training + solve + reload + per-request rewrite routing, separately
reporting.rewrite_information_budget: Hand-engineered symbolic grammar router, supplied canonical repair intents, covers these predeclared operator-authored target phrases. Strong semantic rewrite comparator, not a learned or blind language benchmark.
reporting.exact_cache: Dispatch behavior plus explicitly reused base/semantic-rewrite episode outcomes when effective prompts match; no additional independent episode claim.
reporting.adaptation_information: Closed form accesses internal activations; LoRA uses sampled teacher actions; saved rewrite uses a hand-engineered grammar and the clearer prompt. Same recorded observations and prompts, not identical information or optimization budgets. Rank32 matches module footprint and factor capacity only. LoRA additionally receives the declared learning-rate and closed-loop development selection budget; all trial and validation costs are included.
reporting.cube_only: Full60s horizon; banana maximum displacement<=2cm throughout, cube detached stable final. Early-stop development diagnostic retained but excluded from training/effect claims.
reporting.inference_batching: Initial development used the original dynamic power-of-two server. LoRA development selection and heldout requests are padded to a fixed16 kernel batch, preserving request seeds/order and returning only real requests. Cohorts are reported separately.
reporting.compilation_cache: Existing persistent JAX compilation cache shared across both methods and serving. Report actual stage times; no cold-start speed claim.
